title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 5420 Kavanaugh Boulevard in Little Rock, Arkansas, as the "Ronald A. Robinson Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 5420 Kavanaugh Boulevard in Little Rock, Arkansas, as the Ronald A. Robinson Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress named a Little Rock, Arkansas post office after Ronald A. Robinson.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 5420 Kavanaugh Boulevard in Little Rock, Arkansas, as the Ronald A. Robinson Post Office. It is a naming change only. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or staffing at the office.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the new name applies from that date.
